title: Chapter 2 - Rendelkező hivatkozások Format Mapping
description: Mapping configuration from input data to template placeholders for Chapter 2

{{INTERNATIONAL_STANDARDS_LIST}}.description: Format array of standards into list items: **CODE** -- Title*
{{INTERNATIONAL_STANDARDS_LIST}}.example: **MSZ EN ISO/IEC 17025:2018** -- Vizsgáló- és kalibrálólaboratóriumok felkészültségének általános követelményei*

{{ILAC_DOCUMENTS_LIST}}.description: Format array of documents into list items: **CODE** -- Title*

{{EA_DOCUMENTS_LIST}}.description: Format array of documents into list items: **CODE** -- Title*

{{NAR_DOCUMENTS_LIST}}.description: Format array of documents into list items: **CODE** -- Title*

{{REGULATIONS_LIST}}.description: Format array of regulations into list items: **CODE** rendelet Title*
{{REGULATIONS_LIST}}.example: **1/1990 (IX.29) KHVM** rendelet a gépjárműfenntartó tevékenység feltételeiről*

format_standard_list.description: Converts array of {code, title_hun} objects to formatted strings

format_document_list.description: Converts array of {code, title} objects to formatted strings

format_regulation_list.description: Converts array of {code, title} objects to formatted strings with 'rendelet'
